title: Sedentary Behavior Classification for Wearable Sensors with a CNN-BiLSTM Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.02946v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurate detection of sedentary behavior is important for studying health risks related to prolonged sitting, but posture-based classification remains challenging with wearable sensors, especially at the wrist. We study whether a deep learning model trained on hip-worn accelerometer data can transfer to wrist-worn accelerometer data for sitting versus non-sitting classification. We use CHAP, a CNN-BiLSTM model originally developed for hip accelerometers, and evaluate its zero-shot performance on wrist data as well as its adaptation through finetuning with varying amounts of labeled wrist data. Experiments are conducted on the iWatch dataset with ground-truth posture labels derived from wearable cameras. The hip-trained model performs strongly on hip data without retraining, but accuracy drops on wrist data due to sensor placement shift. Finetuning CHAP provides consistent advantages over transformer models trained from scratch. These

translated_title: 基于CNN-BiLSTM模型的可穿戴传感器久坐行为分类
translated_abstract: 准确检测久坐行为对于研究久坐相关的健康风险非常重要，但基于姿态的分类在使用可穿戴传感器时仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在手腕部位。我们研究在髋部佩戴加速度计数据上训练的深度学习模型能否迁移到手腕佩戴加速度计数据，用于坐姿与非坐姿分类。我们使用CHAP——一个最初为髋部加速度计开发的CNN-BiLSTM模型，评估其在手腕数据上的零样本性能，以及通过不同数量的带标注手腕数据进行微调后的适应能力。实验在iWatch数据集上进行，其中的真实姿态标签来自可穿戴摄像头。结果表明，在髋部数据上训练的模型无需重新训练即可在髋部数据上表现良好，但由于传感器佩戴位置的变化，其在手腕数据上的准确率有所下降。通过微调，CHAP相比从头训练的Transformer模型表现出持续的优势。
tldr: 提出通过对CNN-BiLSTM模型CHAP进行微调，将基于髋部加速度计训练的久坐行为分类模型成功迁移到手腕可穿戴传感器数据上，并持续优于从头训练的Transformer模型。
